'''Politrix''' was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Dark Rendezvous" /> She had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> and was friends with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jang Li-Li]] and [[Jai Maruk]]. Marul had a crush on Politrix while he was a Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and a particular sparring session between the pair left a lasting memory with Maruk.<ref name="Dark Rendezvous" />

Poltrix had be granted the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the wars started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Poltrix was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an ambush with a [[Plasma grenade/Legends|plasma grenade]]. Years later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Dark Rendezvous Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Maruk was reminded of Politrix while on a [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] and reflected on the grief and sorrow that came from loosing so many friends. during the war.<ref name="Dark Rendezvous" />

==Behind the scenes==
Politrix was first mentioned in ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', a novel written by [[Sean Stewart]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="Dark Rendezvous" />
